set.body: From the cold review of 23db27133 (F3). w[probability] < MIN_PROBABILITY admits NaN (Python json parses NaN); use not (p >= MIN_PROBABILITY) and refuse non-finite values (rule 7). Missing or None fields raise untyped exceptions instead of Refusal. Real data has no non-finite values.
set.title: S3c-2 follow-up: fail-closed probability guard and typed refusals for malformed transcript fields
